name: Anton
title: Software Developer
focus: frontend, comfortable across the full stack
availability: Open to freelance and full-time frontend work; usually works in English-speaking international teams.
bio: Software developer with over a decade of experience, focused on frontend and comfortable across the full stack — building Vue/Nuxt and React/Next apps, the TypeScript-heavy interfaces on top, the Node.js/GraphQL services behind them, plus small CLI utilities, editor integrations, and self-hosted systems.
specialties: Vue & Nuxt with TypeScript, and equally React & Next.js
migrating legacy UIs to modern stacks and typing JavaScript end to end
frontend architecture at scale: feature-sliced design, micro-frontends with Module Federation, backend-for-frontend layers, Storybook UI kits
Node.js/TypeScript backends, GraphQL and REST APIs
AI integrations, including streaming model output straight into the interface
alsoDoes: CI/CD pipelines, unit and end-to-end tests, quality gates
small open-source tools: Telegram media bots, terminal helpers, editor plugins, self-hosting experiments
